effects.instruction: Narrator only: locker rooms and bath changing rooms are split into men's and women's. Each person, the player included, changes in the one for their own gender as their character states; nobody walks into, follows anyone into or keeps talking inside the other one: a conversation pauses at the door and picks up again outside. A bare "changing room" or "locker room" means the player's own. Changing clothes anywhere else (in a room, a Quirk transformation) moves nobody: everyone in the scene stays where they are.
